R3B.method: 1 mm a pixel elevation (rail_lib.elevation) at the stated camera height; bars = dark minima of the column profile at z 700..900; rails = dark rows between bars; FWHM includes the blur of a 3 to 4 mm native pixel

bottom_rail_axis_z.how: dark row between the bars at z 440 (rows 2000+: also detected by the column-between-bars profile, depth 19); a flat bar about 18 high

top_rail_axis_z.how: row profile peak, depth 43, FWHM 26 (blur included): a flat bar about 20 high

coping_top_z.how: the stone slab's top at its front lip: the gradient search gives 331 on the plane 110 behind the face; the lip is nearer the camera, so its true height is about 13 higher (the ray falls 110 x (0.97 - 0.35) / 5.2 over that distance)

short_bar_tip_z.how: spear tips of the short bars, which stop just above the middle rail

tall_bar_tip_z.how: spear tips of the tall bars (every second bar), 255 to 285 over the 16k re-measurement of the fresh review, median 2270 (the first version read 2300); 270 above the top rail

post_top_z.how: the finial of the hinge post

post_shaft_width.how: mean of eight rows z 1700 to 1910 (93 to 110), blur included

urn_width.how: the vase under the hinge post's finial, z 2150 to 2210

post_axis_s.how: the hinge post's axis along the plane

pier_width.how: the brick pier under the hinge post, s 2530 to 3080

bar_foot.v: each bar ends in a small ball (about 20 across) just under the bottom rail, 12 below its axis

bar_head.how: (r, z) of a tall bar's head, the fresh review's 16k profile (the first version's 60 across at 2128 was wrong): a ring 40 across at 2030, a turned knop about 92 across at 2098 to 2110, a ring about 44 across at 2145 to 2155, a spire to the tip at 2275; at the first version's height 0.97, +-8

wall_top_z.how: top of the blue bullnose coping, 1 mm and 3 mm elevations

wall_string_z.how: top of the lower blue bullnose string

red_courses_between.how: five red stretcher courses between z 330 and 705 at 75 mm: the scale check on the elevation

bar_pitch_all.how: the thick (tall) bars at s 204, 435, 660, 891, 1110 on the 3 mm preview: 226.5 apart; the thin ones the same, half a pitch between: all bars 113.3 (the first reading, from the far side of the post, gave 116)

tall_first_s.how: the first thick bar with a fleur-de-lis head in the preview window

left_run_max_s.how: the numbers of R3A are the LEFT run's (preview s < 1500 at the first version's height, the spear heads and lily plaques); right of the cast post the photograph shows a second pattern (fleur-de-lis heads about half a pitch out of step) that is not measured

tall_tip_z.how: fleur-de-lis heads of the tall bars

post_top_z.how: the vase and ball on the post, in the oblique view

post_shaft_width.how: oblique view, blur doubled by the 32 degree angle

bar_thick_width.how: the tall bars read 40 to 55 at 1 mm in the oblique view (blur x 2): about 22 across

resolution_mm_per_px_across.how: 5.4 mm native at 7 m, divided by sin 32 degrees along the wall

wall_top_z.how: the strongest brightness step at z 608 to 621 over s 100 to 1000, eight courses plus the coping

bar_tip_z.how: the bars stand 45 above the top rail, with a small spear point

bar_pitch.how: ten bars read at s 1500, 1600, 1695, 1790, 1885, 1975, 2060, 2155, 2250, 2340 on the gridded 1 mm elevation; a line fit gives the pitch and the first bar (two automated searches found 4 bars at rms 12 mm and 65 to 70 mm pitches: the foliage behind the railing defeats them)

bar_centres_s.how: read by eye on the 1 mm elevation, +-6

bar_width.how: blur included: a round bar of 12 to 14

gate_width.how: the leaf between the brick pier and its stile in the 38 degree view, at 5.5 m

gate_top_z.how: the gate's top rail level with the railing's

paint_srgb.how: median of the gate leaf in shade (32, 47, 28) and in light (51, 69, 45)

span_mm.how: axis to axis of the two posts, from their flanges' front edges moved back 143

upper_lug_z.how: the chain's end link at the post, 2 mm elevation

upper_chain_lowest_z.how: lowest dark band of the upper swag at mid-span

lower_chain_lowest_z.how: lowest dark band of the lower swag

post_top_z.how: the dome's top; the bollards target states 1135 at its 1.17 m (4 % higher, inside both errors)

flange_bolts.how: four hex nuts on studs, two seen at the sides and one in front
